messages.subject: Project Tempest - IBR and 13-week cashflow
messages.plaintextBody:
Duncan,

Thank you for getting the independent business review under way. Sterling will want it (and the rolling 13-week cashflow) as a condition precedent to completion, so timing matters - ideally a substantially final IBR by mid-February.

The weekly cashflow shows the group below the proposed £2.5m liquidity line through most of the standstill, with the £8m of net new money restoring headroom at completion. Could you confirm the base-case EBITDA you're using so we can sense-check the covenant headroom grid?

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Tempest - IBR and 13-week cashflow
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Noted on timing - we'll target a substantially final IBR by 13 February. Base-case EBITDA for the 12 months to Dec-25 is £8.6m, building to £9.4m by Dec-26 on the cost actions management has identified. That gives roughly the headroom you'd expect against the 5.00x opening covenant. I'll send the draft IBR and the supporting cashflow next week.

Regards,
Duncan

Duncan Reeves | Partner | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
